description: The Multi-temporal and Multi-dimensional Global Urban Centre Database to Delineate and Analyse World Cities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Michele Melchiorri et al. Monitoring sustainable urban development requires comparable geospatial information on cities across several thematic domains. Here we present the first global database combining such information with city extents. The Global Human Settlement Urban Centre Database (GHS-UCDB) is produced by geospatial data integration to characterise more than 10,000 urban centres worldwide. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: CSV, Excel, GeoPackage. The data are held in European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC) and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
